Restaurant: The Golden Fork - Farm-to-table American cuisine. Located at 123 Main Street, Downtown. Open Tuesday-Sunday, 5pm-10pm. Closed Mondays. Reservations recommended, especially weekends. Smart casual dress code.
Appetizers - Truffle Fries: $12. Hand-cut fries, truffle oil, parmesan, fresh herbs. Vegetarian. Gluten-free option available.
Appetizers - Crispy Calamari: $16. Lightly breaded, served with marinara and lemon aioli. Contains shellfish and gluten.
Appetizers - Burrata Salad: $15. Fresh burrata, heirloom tomatoes, basil, balsamic reduction, extra virgin olive oil. Vegetarian, gluten-free.
Appetizers - Soup of the Day: $9. Chef's daily creation. Ask server for today's selection and dietary information.
Appetizers - Charcuterie Board: $24. Selection of cured meats, artisan cheeses, pickled vegetables, house-made mustard, grilled bread. Serves 2-3.
Salads - Caesar Salad: $14. Romaine hearts, house-made caesar dressing, parmesan crisp, anchovy (optional). Add chicken +$6, salmon +$9, shrimp +$8. Contains gluten and dairy.
Salads - Seasonal Greens: $13. Mixed greens, seasonal vegetables, citrus vinaigrette. Vegan, gluten-free.
Salads - Wedge Salad: $13. Iceberg wedge, blue cheese crumbles, bacon, cherry tomatoes, blue cheese dressing. Contains dairy.
Entrees - Grilled Ribeye: $48. 16oz USDA Prime ribeye, roasted garlic butter, choice of two sides. Cooked to order. Gluten-free.
Entrees - Pan-Seared Salmon: $34. Atlantic salmon, lemon dill sauce, asparagus, fingerling potatoes. Gluten-free. Contains fish.
Entrees - Roasted Chicken: $28. Half chicken, herb jus, mashed potatoes, seasonal vegetables. Gluten-free.
Entrees - Lobster Pasta: $42. Fresh Maine lobster, linguine, cherry tomatoes, light cream sauce, fresh herbs. Contains shellfish, gluten, dairy.
Entrees - Vegetable Risotto: $26. Arborio rice, seasonal vegetables, parmesan, truffle oil. Vegetarian, gluten-free. Can be made vegan (no cheese).
Entrees - Filet Mignon: $52. 8oz center-cut filet, red wine reduction, choice of two sides. Gluten-free.
Entrees - Braised Short Ribs: $36. Slow-braised beef short ribs, creamy polenta, gremolata. Gluten-free.
Entrees - Grilled Swordfish: $38. Fresh swordfish steak, Mediterranean salsa, couscous, grilled vegetables. Contains fish and gluten.
Sides: $8 each. Options: Mashed Potatoes (GF), Truffle Mac & Cheese, Grilled Asparagus (GF, vegan), Roasted Brussels Sprouts (GF, vegan), Creamed Spinach (GF), Sweet Potato Fries (GF).
Kids Menu (12 and under): Chicken Fingers & Fries $12, Pasta with Butter or Marinara $10, Grilled Cheese $10, Mini Burger & Fries $14. All kids meals include choice of drink.
Desserts - Chocolate Lava Cake: $12. Warm chocolate cake, molten center, vanilla ice cream. Contains gluten, dairy, eggs. Prepare time: 15 minutes.
Desserts - Crème Brûlée: $10. Classic vanilla custard, caramelized sugar top. Gluten-free. Contains dairy and eggs.
Desserts - Seasonal Fruit Tart: $11. Fresh seasonal fruits, pastry cream, butter crust. Contains gluten, dairy, eggs.
Desserts - Cheesecake: $11. New York style, graham cracker crust, berry compote. Contains gluten, dairy, eggs.
Desserts - Gelato Selection: $9. Three scoops, chef's selection of flavors. Ask server for today's options. Most are gluten-free.
Beverages - Soft Drinks: $4. Coca-Cola, Diet Coke, Sprite, Ginger Ale, Lemonade. Free refills.
Beverages - Coffee & Tea: $4. Regular or decaf coffee. Hot tea selection. Espresso $5, Cappuccino $6.
Beverages - Fresh Juices: $6. Orange, grapefruit, apple, cranberry.
Wine - White: Chardonnay (CA) $12/glass $48/bottle. Sauvignon Blanc (NZ) $13/glass $52/bottle. Pinot Grigio (Italy) $11/glass $44/bottle.
Wine - Red: Cabernet Sauvignon (Napa) $14/glass $56/bottle. Pinot Noir (Oregon) $13/glass $52/bottle. Malbec (Argentina) $12/glass $48/bottle.
Wine - Sparkling: Prosecco $11/glass $44/bottle. Champagne (France) $18/glass $90/bottle.
Cocktails: Signature Martini $15. Old Fashioned $14. Margarita $13. Moscow Mule $13. Aperol Spritz $12. Mocktails available $8.
Beer: Local craft beers on tap $8. Imported bottles $9. Domestic bottles $6. Ask server for current tap selection.

Allergies and Dietary Restrictions: Please inform your server of any allergies. Kitchen handles nuts, shellfish, dairy, gluten. Cross-contamination possible. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options marked on menu. Chef can modify many dishes upon request.
Private Events: Private dining room seats up to 20 guests. Semi-private space for up to 40. Custom menus available. Minimum spend applies on weekends. Contact events@goldenfork.com or call 555-0123.

Reservations: Book online at goldenfork.com or call 555-0100. Same-day reservations subject to availability. Large parties (6+) please call. Cancellation policy: 24 hours notice required or $25/person charge.
Gift Cards: Available in any amount. Purchase in restaurant or online. Never expire. Can be used for dining, private events, or merchandise.
Happy Hour: Tuesday-Friday, 5pm-6:30pm. $2 off all drinks. Half-price appetizers. Bar seating only.

Hours and Location: Tuesday-Thursday 5pm-9pm. Friday-Saturday 5pm-10pm. Sunday 5pm-8pm. Closed Monday. 123 Main Street, Downtown. Valet parking $10. Street parking available. Nearest parking garage on Oak Street.
